Progress indicator for large report exports
C001.notes: Consistently happy customer across all three documents. Complaints are phrased as minor UX nice-to-haves, not blockers. Good candidate for expansion/advocacy, invited to customer advisory call.

pain_points: Repeated platform outages/downtime (three incidents in one quarter) disrupting live dispatch operations
WMS (warehouse management system) integration ticket open for months, forcing manual double data entry

Improved platform uptime / reliability (implicit SLA expectation)
C002.notes: Explicit churn signals: client states they are actively evaluating competitor platforms and that renewal window opens in November. Sentiment is openly negative by the final chat transcript, despite acknowledging individual support reps are helpful.

pain_points: Permissions/roles screen is confusing for less technical or newer staff during onboarding
No self-serve audit log export for compliance reviews
No SSO / centralized login via Azure AD, repeatedly requested but unscheduled
Same requests raised multiple times over months with no resolution, despite polite tone

C003.notes: This is the 'silent churn' profile: language stays polite and grateful throughout ('no rush', 'not urgent', 'appreciate you'), but CSAT drops from 5 (June) to 3 (September) and the same unresolved requests keep resurfacing with increasing internal pressure (compliance team, hospital-system leadership). A sentiment model reading only tone/politeness would miss the risk; the risk shows in repetition and CSAT trend, not word choice.

pain_points: Mobile app randomly logs user out when switching networks

Itemized invoices are more detailed than needed, proration charges were confusing initially
C004.notes: Small solo-consultant account. Genuine but low-severity complaints; overall relationship is healthy and CSAT is 4/5. Root cause of two separate-seeming complaints (mobile logout + calendar sync) turned out to be the same session-expiry bug.

C005.churn_risk: medium if SSO request stalls further, tied to renewal timing

Performance improvement for large-dataset reporting dashboards
C005.notes: SSO request here is framed as a compliance/security-audit requirement, not a convenience, and the client explicitly links a slow resolution to renewal risk. Same underlying feature request as C003 and C006 (SSO / centralized login), phrased differently each time, which is intentional for testing feature-request clustering.

C006.overall_sentiment: positive, leaning mixed on operational friction
pain_points: High volume of password reset helpdesk tickets (8-10/week) because login isn't tied to company Google Workspace account
Comment/collaboration notifications only appear in-app, not via Slack or email digest
feature_requests: Federated login / SSO, specifically 'log in with Google' (Google Workspace) or a general identity-provider integration
Slack notifications or email digest for document comment activity
C006.notes: Third client requesting the same underlying capability (SSO/centralized login) as C003 and C005, framed here as an operational helpdesk-burden problem rather than compliance. Useful for testing whether an analysis pipeline correctly clusters 'SSO', 'Azure AD login', 'Okta integration', and 'log in with Google' as the same feature request.
